pointnav: recurrent state and self-issued action history
robothor: recurrent state and self-issued action history

attribution.alt: Original RGB and Grad-CAM pairs for Alarm Clock, Apple, Baseball Bat, Basketball, Bowl and Garbage Can; four rows, three goals per model row.
Original RGB and Grad-CAM pairs for House Plant, Laptop, Mug, Spray Bottle, Television and Vase; four rows, three goals per model row.

attribution_manifest.selection_rule: Illustrative successful terminal views selected for recognizable target objects. Laptop and Vase are additionally selected for genuine target-overlapping End-action Grad-CAM, without altering maps, gradients, checkpoints or normalization. This selection does not estimate typical localization accuracy or causal model superiority.

attribution_record.limits: Illustrative examples selected partly for target visibility and target-aligned genuine End-action Grad-CAM; not a localization benchmark or a causal proof of navigation advantage.
attribution_record.method: End-action log-probability Grad-CAM at CLIP RN50 final convolutional features
attribution_record.normalization: Within-map positive maximum; identical rule for both models. Compare spatial distribution, not gradient brightness.
attribution_record.rendering: Each model uses its own successful terminal RGB and reconstructed or actually saved recurrent state, as specified by the source analysis and per-record provenance. Original validation pose replays and fixed-seed autonomous validation samples are both explicitly identified.

selection.comparison: Each model uses its own successful terminal view and history; shared episode for eleven categories, BaseballBat uses different successful episodes. Vase GaWF uses a new fixed-seed autonomous rollout; the other entries are verified validation pose replays. Visual inputs and terminal states are not held identical.
selection.inference_boundary: No poses, maps, simulator labels or metrics enter either policy; evaluator metadata is used only for rendering and verification.
selection.purpose: Illustrative successful terminal views selected for recognizable target objects. Laptop and Vase are additionally selected for genuine target-overlapping End-action Grad-CAM, without altering maps, gradients, checkpoints or normalization. This selection does not estimate typical localization accuracy or causal model superiority.

AlarmClock.reason: Large recognizable alarm clock in both own successful terminal views; GaWF highlight covers clock face.

HousePlant.reason: Leaves and plant pot are clearly visible in model input; no claim that its stop map is centered on the plant.

Laptop.reason: Laptop screen and keyboard visible; GaWF high-response region covers screen/hinge.

Vase.reason: Actual successful autonomous End decision; large blue vase visible and genuine positive Grad-CAM overlaps vase body.

pointnav_protocol.dataset: The same Gibson PointNav v2 episodes and licensed Gibson Habitat scene files as light RGB-D
pointnav_protocol.goal_protocol: pointgoal is the constant initial-frame goal cue g0, repeated without online updates
pointnav_protocol.internal_state: previous self-issued action and recurrent state
pointnav_protocol.relationship_to_rgbd: Independent RGB-only protocol; RGB-D checkpoints and validation scores are not comparable results
pointnav_protocol.training_reward: Official NavRLEnv geodesic shaping remains training supervision; reward and info are not policy inputs

execution.policy_sampling: categorical multinomial with dedicated seeded CUDA generator

selection.candidate_rule: fixed pool from prior validation outcomes, including requested Apple/Mug/Vase and successful-stop probe candidates; all actual recordings retained; presentation selects clear GaWF benefits
selection.checkpoint_rule: highest common-validation SR over all five completed seeds per model, then SPL and lower seed
selection.recording_rule: one prespecified policy seed0 and simulator seed1000 for both policies; no action rerolls

selection: Outcome-selected qualitative examples from one fixed recorded candidate pool; all original candidates retained; no action rerolls. These examples are not aggregate performance estimates.
